Enrollment Definition/Registration
data.description: Participant is considered enrolled only after signing ICF, being eligible and being registered with assignment of participant number
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: Safety Review Committee Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: SRC must review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Precluding Dose Increase
data.description: Participants may remain at 15 mg/day if up-titration poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing for ALXN1840 will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case, participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Discharge/Retention in CRU on Day 9
data.description: Discharge on Day 9 is conditional; participant may remain in CRU for safety or study integrity at CRU discretion
data.text: Participants will be admitted to the CRU for Treatment Period 1 on Day -8 and may be discharged on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Extension of the Outpatient Period requires Investigator approval, provision of additional investigational product, and documentation of the actual duration; participant resumes Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period. In such cases, the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion within prespecified limits without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Trigger (Bilirubin/ALT)
data.description: Bilirubin elevation accompanied by ALT elevation indicative of liver injury triggers temporary interruption
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: Temporary interruption; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Dose Modification Trigger (Neutrophils)
data.description: Greater than 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils when baseline is below reference range triggers dose reduction and prohibits further dose increase until resolution
data.text: > 30% ↓ from baseline, neutrophils below reference range at baseline: Reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose ↑ until resolution of abnormality. Weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Assessment Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening requires Investigator and Medical Monitor evaluation for dose modification, documentation, and re-evaluation at next study visit
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data. Rationale for dosing decision must be documented in study record and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Assessment Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening (including suicidality, acute depression, psychosis) requires evaluation for dose modification
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data.

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Rechallenge allowed only under specified conditions with maximum number and dose specified
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. For rechallenges, participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding After Enrollment
data.description: Investigator determines whether the participant can continue in the study following a clinically significant finding such as QTcF change from baseline
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Required for Enrollment of WOCBP
data.description: Women of childbearing potential may only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test at Screening
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Physical Examination Condition Prior to Discharge
data.description: Full physical examination required at Screening, check-in, and EOS/ET; additional exam for participants with ongoing AEs prior to discharge
data.text: A full physical examination will be performed at Screening, at check-in for the study, and at the End of the study/Early Termination Visit. A physical examination should also be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit.

data.name: US Screening-Only Site Condition
data.description: Sites in the US may perform only screening procedures and not the remaining study procedures
data.text: Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures.

data.name: Screening to Enrollment/Run-in Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day -7 and initiated on a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet; participants are admitted to the CRU on Day -8 for Treatment Period 1.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (Day -7 through Day -1), participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1 for a treatment period of approximately 28 days.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the clinical research unit (CRU) on Day 9 to return on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose); at the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who are discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 for Treatment Period 2 and will remain in house until Day 40; all procedures will start on Day 23.

data.name: Dose Titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants will be initiated on ALXN1840 at 15 mg once daily and increased to 30 mg once daily on Day 29, after the Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Treatment Period 2 to End of Study Follow-up
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods of the study (ie, Day 40), participants will transition to prior therapy, other standard of care, or preapproval access ALXN1840; all participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days).

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: Neutrophils > 30% decreased from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Liver Injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurologic or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data for evidence of neurologic worsening or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening.

data.name: Rechallenge After Dose Interruption
data.text: Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor; a maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed; participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes that it is in best interest of the participant.

data.name: Mandatory Consideration for Study Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur during the study: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it is necessary for the participant.

data.name: Continuation in Study After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. The participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Withdrawal
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before a participant is deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter). Should the participant continue to be unreachable, he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, consider and request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (the EOS Visit on Day 54 +/- 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (EOS/ET Visit) should be conducted as shown in the SoA, with data collected at the time of study discontinuation and follow-up.

data.name: Voluntary Withdrawal
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request; if the participant withdraws consent for disclosure of future information, Alexion may retain and use data collected before withdrawal; the participant may request destruction of untested samples.

data.name: Investigator-Initiated Withdrawal
data.description: Participant may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Exit
data.description: Participant who repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted after documented attempts (3 telephone calls and a certified letter) will be considered lost to follow-up and to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Safety-Related Discontinuation Exit
data.description: Exit from study intervention following serious hypersensitivity reaction, severe uncontrolled infection, use of disallowed medication, pregnancy or planned pregnancy, or when Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason; reasons may include Investigator noncompliance with the protocol, IRB/IEC or health authority requirements, Alexion's procedures or GCP guidelines, inadequate recruitment, or discontinuation of further study intervention development. If prematurely terminated or suspended, the Investigator shall promptly inform participants and assure appropriate therapy and/or follow-up.

data.name: Site Closure
data.description: A study site is considered closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit, all data have been collected and entered into the EDC system, all required documents and study supplies have been collected, and a study-site closure visit has been performed.

data.name: Eligibility/Enrollment Decision
data.description: On Day -7, eligible consented participants are registered, assigned a participant number, and initiated on the copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet.

data.name: Day 9 Discharge vs CRU Retention Decision
data.description: Decision at Day 9 whether to discharge the participant to the Outpatient Period or retain in the CRU for safety or study conduct integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decision to extend the Outpatient Period by up to an additional 14 days, with provision of additional investigational product and documentation of actual duration.

data.name: Safety Review Committee Titration Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the SRC reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; participants may remain on 15 mg/day if safety concerns exist.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision Based on Safety Laboratory Results
data.description: Dose reduction, temporary interruption, restriction of dose increase, or rechallenge decisions based on bilirubin/ALT and hematology criteria, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose interruption, increase, or decrease based on copper control parameters and clinical data; rationale documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Continuation Decision After Clinically Significant ECG Finding
data.description: Investigator or qualified designee determines if the participant can continue in the study and whether any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Decision at Day 40
data.description: At the end of inpatient Period 2 (Day 40), decision whether participant resumes prior therapy, other standard of care therapy, or requests continued ALXN1840 via preapproval access.
